summary: AmperCap Acquisition Co filed an 8-K reporting the partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option in connection with its June 2026 IPO. On June 10, 2026, underwriters purchased 1,837,500 additional units at $10.00/unit, generating $18.375M in gross proceeds; the remaining 37,500 option units were not exercised. The filing also notes the completion of the IPO and a concurrent private placement of 512,500 units to the sponsor and others at the same price. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine post-IPO exercise of a greenshoe.
